sentences.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
sentences.zh: 我很期待听到你对这个问题的看法。

sentences.en: Hearing you sing, people might take you for a girl.
sentences.zh: 你唱歌的时候听起来像是个女孩。

sentences.en: Hearing the monster's footsteps, they began running in all directions.
sentences.zh: 听到那个怪物的脚步声后，他们四下逃散了。
